rationale: IEC 60076-7 exponential top-oil model: steady-state rise = 55*((1+5K^2)/6)^0.8, applied with tau=3h from the previous end-of-step rise (initial 41.3 K). Hot-spot = top-oil + 23*K^1.3. Ageing rate = 2^((hot_spot-98)/6); equivalent ageing summed over steps. Max hot-spot 104.65 C is within 120 C.
